newsitem.title: USA: Grand Union sells $40 mln of pfrd shrs.
newsitem.headline: Grand Union sells $40 mln of pfrd shrs.

text.p: Grand Union Co said on Tuesday it completed the sale of $40 million of a total of $100 million of 8.5 percent Class A convertible preferred stock to an investment group over an 18-month period.
The company announced in July plans to sell $100 million of preferred stock to fund 78 projects over the next three years, including new stores, replacement stores and enlarging existing locations.
The conversion price of the preferred stock is $7.25 per share.
The investment group that bought the stock consists of Trefoil Capital Investors II LP, which is an investment vehicle for Roy E. Disney's family, and General Electric Co's GE Investments.

Subsequent $20 million purchases of preferred stock will be made in Febuary 1997, August 1997 and February 1998, Grand Union said. Dividends are payable quarterly in cash, additional shares of convertible preferred stock or common stock, the company said.
Grand Union said it has named Clifford Miller, Geoffrey Moore, James Costello and J. Richard Stonesifer to its board, as a result of the investment.
